narrative.overview:
The built 0.3 native .NET 8 WinForms interface follows the user's dashboard concept: pale cool surfaces, navy/slate text, rounded bordered cards and restrained teal interaction/data accents. Dark mode uses charcoal surfaces, soft white text and brighter teal. Native inputs, Windows chrome and tray conventions remain. No WebView, external fonts or UI packages were added.

This replaces the obsolete narrow, read-only, blue-accent system. Source authority: `UI/Theme.cs`, `MainForm.cs`, `DashboardControls.cs`, `NativeAppearance.cs`, `ThemeSettings.cs`, `TrayContext.cs`. Frontmatter records source RGB tuples; typography px values are calculated 96-DPI equivalents of native point sizes, not physical glyph measurements. Geometry is baseline WinForms units, not CSS implementation.
keyCharacteristics: Overview, Cooling and Diagnostics navigation; System/Light/Dark selection.
Monitoring/current curve on the left; performance/cooling actions on the right in the wide layout.
Editable drafts, explicit Apply, independent readback and honest unavailable/stale states.
Compact wrapping/manual scroll; refresh preserves the viewport while keyboard navigation reveals off-screen controls.

rules.name: System Contrast
rules.body: High contrast overrides palettes: background/surface/selected → Window; ink/muted/border/warning → WindowText; accent → Highlight; accent-ink → HighlightText. Preference changes reapply colors. Physical high-contrast/disabled-state compliance is not certified.

rules.name: Complete Reading
rules.body: Measure text at available width, not single-line height. Retain CPU °C, fan target '(not RPM)' and source/calibration qualifications. Sensor cards grow with content. Measure the brand before placing identity beside it. Dynamic label screen-reader announcements remain unverified.

rules.name: Stable Refresh
rules.body: Scroll suppression applies only within synchronous programmatic state/render/layout scopes, never across a sample await or deliberate keyboard navigation. Fresh safe drafts stay enabled during reads; Apply/Restore are blocked. Capability loss/staleness still fail closed. Tab/Shift+Tab reveal lower actions.

dos: preserve semantic palettes and full units/source notes in both themes.
distinguish staged choice, observed hardware state, backend result and independent readback.
preserve keyboard/manual scrolling while suppressing only programmatic refresh reveal.
label fixture captures and retain provenance.
donts: invent calibrated RPM, unsupported controls or a hardware-verified badge.
add lifecycle writes or weaken existing curve bounds.
claim physical accessibility or resource targets from fixture tests.
reuse the obsolete read-only finish verdict as this release's approval.

review.scope: Independent bounded six-fix verdict: all six resolved. See docs/dashboard-finish-review.md. Not hardware, physical accessibility or resource certification.
